renderer: Offline Chromium / Edge using actual page CSS and markup
scope: 375px member and free pages; primary/secondary buttons, green action links, selected chips and navigation labels. This is a limited readability check, not a whole-screen WCAG certification.
method: Nine rendered background samples per control, removing glyphs and images without changing layout. Contrast uses computed foreground and sampled gradient/composited surface. Does not count text shadow. Disabled controls are reported but exempt from failures.
limitations: Transparent bar content changes while scrolling. Removing background glyphs isolates intended surface colors; overlapping moving text and device-specific blur require visual/device review. Icon shape and icon contrast are not part of this test.
